equipment.name: Cane Sword
equipment.description:
##### Cane Sword

_Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing, 3 lbs, 35 gp_

A rapier hidden within a walking aid. It can be used both within its sheath as a bludgeon, or drawn to dual wield the sheath with the blade. The sheath becomes a light club like this. While sheathed, you can use Deception instead of Sleight of Hand for Conceal. A expert has perfected turning the sheath into a deadly aid to the blade itself.

Untrained Awkward, One-Handed, Finesse, Melee d6, Entangle, Trip

Basic One-Handed, Finesse, Melee d6, Conceal, Entangle, Puncture, Trip

Expert One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d8, Conceal, Entangle, Puncture, Riposte, Trip

Expert Perk
While dual wielding the cane and sword, the cane gains Deflect d8, and if you hit with an attack with the cane you can deal only your Dexterity modifier in damage, minimum 1, and give yourself advantage on your next attack.
tiers: Untrained Awkward, One-Handed, Finesse, Melee d6, Entangle, Trip
Basic One-Handed, Finesse, Melee d6, Conceal, Entangle, Puncture, Trip
Expert One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d8, Conceal, Entangle, Puncture, Riposte, Trip
equipment.expertPerk: While dual wielding the cane and sword, the cane gains Deflect d8, and if you hit with an attack with the cane you can deal only your Dexterity modifier in damage, minimum 1, and give yourself advantage on your next attack.

equipment.name: Compass Blade
equipment.description:
##### Compass Blade

_Piercing or Slashing, 1.5 lbs, 100 gp_

A wheel blade held by the center, that when a trigger is pressed, four blades deploy in a cross shape. When not deployed, this weapon has the Nimble property. When deployed, it loses Nimble but gains Deflect. Deploying the blades from the wheel takes an object interaction. The expert can effectively use all four blades in a single strike.

Untrained Awkward, One-Handed, Finesse, Melee 1d4, Thrown (40/60), Clockwork, Wound

Basic One-Handed, Finesse, Melee 2d4, Thrown (40/60), Clockwork, Keen, Wound

Expert One-Handed, Finesse, Melee 2d4, Thrown (60/60), Clockwork, Double Ended 2d4, Keen, Wound

Expert Perk
When you deploy the blades, your Double Ended attack on your turn gains advantage.
tiers: Untrained Awkward, One-Handed, Finesse, Melee 1d4, Thrown (40/60), Clockwork, Wound
Basic One-Handed, Finesse, Melee 2d4, Thrown (40/60), Clockwork, Keen, Wound
Expert One-Handed, Finesse, Melee 2d4, Thrown (60/60), Clockwork, Double Ended 2d4, Keen, Wound
equipment.expertPerk: When you deploy the blades, your Double Ended attack on your turn gains advantage.

equipment.name: Gauntlet
equipment.description:
##### Gauntlet

_Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing, 1 lb, 3 gp_

Spiked or weighted knuckles worn as a glove or held in hand. A expert can catch an enemy's weapon mid-swing, potentially disarming them. The hand with the gauntlet cannot be used to wield other equipment.

Untrained One-Handed, Affixed, Melee d4, Deflect

Basic One-Handed, Affixed, Melee d6, Deflect, Disarm, Nimble, Riposte

Expert One-Handed, Affixed, Melee d6, Deflect, Disarm, Nimble, Riposte, Stagger

Expert Perk
When you are hit with a melee attack, as a reaction before the damage, you can attempt a Disarm attack. If you disarm the enemy, you take no damage and come into possession of the weapon.
tiers: Untrained One-Handed, Affixed, Melee d4, Deflect
Basic One-Handed, Affixed, Melee d6, Deflect, Disarm, Nimble, Riposte
Expert One-Handed, Affixed, Melee d6, Deflect, Disarm, Nimble, Riposte, Stagger
equipment.expertPerk: When you are hit with a melee attack, as a reaction before the damage, you can attempt a Disarm attack. If you disarm the enemy, you take no damage and come into possession of the weapon.

equipment.name: Hidden Blade
equipment.description:
##### Hidden Blade

_Piercing, 1 lb, 50 gp_

A mechanical means to deploy a piercing dagger from under the wrist built into a bracer. The expert takes full advantage of a surprise attack, ending a life in an instant.

Untrained Awkward, One-Handed, Affixed, Finesse, Melee d4, Clockwork, Conceal, Nimble, Slip

Basic One-Handed, Affixed, Finesse, Melee d4, Clockwork, Conceal, Nimble, Puncture, Slip

Expert One-Handed, Affixed, Finesse, Melee d4, Clockwork, Conceal, Nimble, Puncture, Slip

Expert Perk
Surprised creatures take maximum damage from this weapon and any attachers.
tiers: Untrained Awkward, One-Handed, Affixed, Finesse, Melee d4, Clockwork, Conceal, Nimble, Slip
Basic One-Handed, Affixed, Finesse, Melee d4, Clockwork, Conceal, Nimble, Puncture, Slip
Expert One-Handed, Affixed, Finesse, Melee d4, Clockwork, Conceal, Nimble, Puncture, Slip
equipment.expertPerk: Surprised creatures take maximum damage from this weapon and any attachers.

equipment.name: Interceptor
equipment.description:
##### Interceptor

_Bludgeoning, 1 lbs, 3 gp_

A thick wool cloak, silk scarf, wide brimmed hat, or any thick clothing. To be used, it must be equipped and gives you +1 Shield AC. It only deals damage equal to your weapon ability modifier. The expert can catch missile weapons in flight, even protecting an ally.

Untrained Awkward, One-Handed, Affixed, Melee.

Basic One-Handed, Affixed, Finesse, Melee, Conceal, Deflect (d6)

Expert One-Handed, Affixed, Finesse, Melee, Conceal, Deflect (d8), Disarm, Entangle, Trip

Expert Perk

Your Deflect can be used against ranged weapon attacks. When a creature you can see attacks a target within 5 ft of you, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage.
tiers: Untrained Awkward, One-Handed, Affixed, Melee.
Basic One-Handed, Affixed, Finesse, Melee, Conceal, Deflect (d6)
Expert One-Handed, Affixed, Finesse, Melee, Conceal, Deflect (d8), Disarm, Entangle, Trip
equipment.expertPerk: Your Deflect can be used against ranged weapon attacks. When a creature you can see attacks a target within 5 ft of you, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage.

equipment.name: Katar
equipment.description:
##### Katar

_Piercing or Slashing, 1 lbs, 5 gp_

A wide, leaf shaped blade mounted in line with the fist at the end of an H shaped handle. The katar is a unique punch weapon, and the expert's speed and precision is unmatched.

Untrained Awkward, One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d4, Conceal, Keen, Nimble

Basic One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d4, Conceal, Keen, Nimble

Expert One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d6, Conceal, Keen, Nimble

Expert Perk
When you score a powerful blow, you can make one additional attack as part of this same action. If dual wielding katars, these extra attacks also activate this ability.
tiers: Untrained Awkward, One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d4, Conceal, Keen, Nimble
Basic One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d4, Conceal, Keen, Nimble
Expert One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d6, Conceal, Keen, Nimble
equipment.expertPerk: When you score a powerful blow, you can make one additional attack as part of this same action. If dual wielding katars, these extra attacks also activate this ability.

equipment.name: Knuckle Axe
equipment.description:
##### Knuckle Axe

_Piercing or Slashing, 1 lb, 10 gp_

An axe head with no shaft and a curved handle in the bit to rest inside a closed fist. experts slash through soft targets much like a real axe, attacking two targets at once.

Untrained Awkward, One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d4, Keen

Basic One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d6, Deflect, Keen

Expert One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d6, Deflect, Keen

Expert Perk
When wielding one knuckle axe, if you reduce a target to 0 hit points, you can make another attack as part of the same action. If wielding two knuckle axes, this extra attack also happens when you score a critical hit. This perk can only happen once per attack it was caused by.
tiers: Untrained Awkward, One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d4, Keen
Basic One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d6, Deflect, Keen
Expert One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d6, Deflect, Keen
equipment.expertPerk: When wielding one knuckle axe, if you reduce a target to 0 hit points, you can make another attack as part of the same action. If wielding two knuckle axes, this extra attack also happens when you score a critical hit. This perk can only happen once per attack it was caused by.

equipment.name: Punch Dagger
equipment.description:
##### Punch Dagger

_Piercing, 0.5 lbs, 1 gp_

A horizontal handle that projects a knife from the fist when held. It can be easily deployed in a swift punching motion allowing a expert true speed and precision unmatched.

Untrained One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d4, Conceal, Nimble

Basic One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d4, Conceal, Nimble, Punch

Expert One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d4, Conceal, Nimble, Punch

Expert Perk
You have advantage on attacks made outside of your turn. If this weapon is off-hand, you can make an opportunity attack with both weapons.
tiers: Untrained One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d4, Conceal, Nimble
Basic One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d4, Conceal, Nimble, Punch
Expert One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d4, Conceal, Nimble, Punch
equipment.expertPerk: You have advantage on attacks made outside of your turn. If this weapon is off-hand, you can make an opportunity attack with both weapons.

equipment.name: Side Baton
equipment.description:
##### Side Baton

_Bludgeoning, 2 lbs, 5 gp_

A Tonfa, Riot Baton, or Arm Club designed to deflect attacks with the forearm using a perpendicular handle. A expert uses the handle as a hook or an axe and maximizes the defensive properties of this weapon.

Untrained One-Handed, Light, Melee d4, Deflect

Basic One-Handed, Light, Melee d6, Deflect, Riposte

Expert One-Handed, Light, Melee d8, Deflect, Riposte, Trip

Expert Perk

You gain +1 weapon AC. You gain Deflect d10, and you can add your proficiency to this roll.
tiers: Untrained One-Handed, Light, Melee d4, Deflect
Basic One-Handed, Light, Melee d6, Deflect, Riposte
Expert One-Handed, Light, Melee d8, Deflect, Riposte, Trip
equipment.expertPerk: You gain +1 weapon AC. You gain Deflect d10, and you can add your proficiency to this roll.

equipment.name: War Fan
equipment.description:
##### War Fan

_Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing, 1 lb, 10 gp_

A bladed or weaponized foldable fan, when this weapon is unfolded, you gain +1 Weapon AC but lose Conceal. Folding and unfolding the fan is a free action on your turn. The expert uses the wide blades to deflect any ranged attacks.

Untrained Awkward, One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d4, Conceal, Keen, Wound

Basic One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d4, Conceal, Keen, Wound

Expert One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d4, Conceal, Deflect, Keen, Wound

Expert Perk
While unfolded, your Deflect can be used against ranged attacks with Deflect 2d6. While folded, your weapon gains Stagger and Melee d6.
tiers: Untrained Awkward, One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d4, Conceal, Keen, Wound
Basic One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d4, Conceal, Keen, Wound
Expert One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d4, Conceal, Deflect, Keen, Wound
equipment.expertPerk: While unfolded, your Deflect can be used against ranged attacks with Deflect 2d6. While folded, your weapon gains Stagger and Melee d6.

equipment.name: Battle Axe
equipment.description:
##### Battle Axe

_Slashing, 4 lbs, 10 gp_

An medium length axe with a longer beard designed for a wider slashing wound, large enough to use with two hands for more powerful strikes, yet nimble enough to be used in one hand. experts with the battle axe find reliable damage, and throw the axe with an overhand pitch with both hands.

Untrained Awkward, Two-Handed, Melee d8

Basic One-Handed, Melee d8, Versatile d10, Trip

Expert One-Handed, Melee d10, Versatile d12, Trip

Expert Perk 
You can reroll any result of 1 or 2 on any damage die caused by this weapon or attachers. If you are wielding the Battle Axe with two hands, it gains Thrown d12 (20/60).
tiers: Untrained Awkward, Two-Handed, Melee d8
Basic One-Handed, Melee d8, Versatile d10, Trip
Expert One-Handed, Melee d10, Versatile d12, Trip
equipment.expertPerk: You can reroll any result of 1 or 2 on any damage die caused by this weapon or attachers. If you are wielding the Battle Axe with two hands, it gains Thrown d12 (20/60).

equipment.name: Broadaxe
equipment.description:
##### Broadaxe

_Slashing, 5 lb, 15 gp_

Any cleaver type axe with a wide blade mounted to a pole at two or more different points, including more historical versions such as the bardiche, voulge, or epsilon. A broadaxe rivals the greataxe in power, but the size and weight of the cleaver-like head puts more force with less cut behind the strike. The expert leverages this force to great effect.

Untrained Awkward, Two-Handed, Heavy, Melee d10

Basic Two-Handed, Heavy, Melee 2d6, Punch, Sunder

Expert Two-Handed, Heavy, Melee 2d6, Punch, Stagger, Sunder

Expert Perk
When you score a mighty blow, your enemy is Staggered and cannot save to resist.
tiers: Untrained Awkward, Two-Handed, Heavy, Melee d10
Basic Two-Handed, Heavy, Melee 2d6, Punch, Sunder
Expert Two-Handed, Heavy, Melee 2d6, Punch, Stagger, Sunder
equipment.expertPerk: When you score a mighty blow, your enemy is Staggered and cannot save to resist.

equipment.name: Greataxe
equipment.description:
##### Greataxe

_Slashing, 6 lbs, 10 gp_

The classic barbarian axe, with one or two blades nearly as tall and wide as its wielder, with examples being the dane axe, executioner, or parashu. The greataxe has incredible potential for damage, and the expert greataxe wielder fells even the stoutest of foes with reliability not seen in many other weapon styles.

Untrained Awkward, Two-Handed, Heavy, Melee d10

Basic Two-Handed, Heavy, Melee d12, Disarm, Trip

Expert Two-Handed, Heavy, Melee 2d8, Disarm, Knockback, Trip

Expert Perk
When you score a mighty blow you add an additional damage die.
tiers: Untrained Awkward, Two-Handed, Heavy, Melee d10
Basic Two-Handed, Heavy, Melee d12, Disarm, Trip
Expert Two-Handed, Heavy, Melee 2d8, Disarm, Knockback, Trip
equipment.expertPerk: When you score a mighty blow you add an additional damage die.

equipment.name: Halberd
equipment.description:
##### Halberd

_Piercing or Slashing, 7 lbs, 35 gp_

An axe topped with a spike mounted on an 8ft long shaft, with a hook on the back side of the axe blade. A halberd expert has perfected pulling foes to the ground.

Untrained Awkward, Two-Handed, Heavy, Melee d10, Brace

Basic Two-Handed, Heavy, Reach, Melee 2d6, Brace, Trip

Expert Two-Handed, Heavy, Reach, Melee 2d6, Brace, Entangle, Puncture, Trip

Expert Perk
Your Trip attacks impose disadvantage to saving throws made to resist them.
tiers: Untrained Awkward, Two-Handed, Heavy, Melee d10, Brace
Basic Two-Handed, Heavy, Reach, Melee 2d6, Brace, Trip
Expert Two-Handed, Heavy, Reach, Melee 2d6, Brace, Entangle, Puncture, Trip
equipment.expertPerk: Your Trip attacks impose disadvantage to saving throws made to resist them.

equipment.name: Handaxe
equipment.description:
##### Handaxe

_Slashing, 2 lbs, 5 gp_

A utilitarian weapon and tool, the expert binds and disarms with lightning efficiency. If you have a handaxe on your person, you gain advantage on Survival checks where the handaxe can be used to help, such as cutting firewood or putting up tents.

Untrained One-Handed, Melee d6, Thrown (10/30)

Basic One-Handed, Light, Melee d6, Thrown (20/60), Trip

Expert One-Handed, Light, Melee d6, Thrown (20/60), Disarm, Trip

Expert Perk
If you miss with a Disarm attack, you can reroll but must take the new result.
tiers: Untrained One-Handed, Melee d6, Thrown (10/30)
Basic One-Handed, Light, Melee d6, Thrown (20/60), Trip
Expert One-Handed, Light, Melee d6, Thrown (20/60), Disarm, Trip
equipment.expertPerk: If you miss with a Disarm attack, you can reroll but must take the new result.

equipment.name: Hook Sword
equipment.description:
##### Hook Sword

_Slashing, 2 lbs, 60 gp_

An irregular weapon made famous by northern Chinese experts; a shortsword with a prominent hook and crescent bladed knuckle guard. The expert can join two hook swords together for a unique means of attack, as well as striking further by forming a makeshift flail.

Untrained Awkward, One-Handed, Melee d6

Basic One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d6, Disarm, Trip, Wound

Expert One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d6, Disarm, Entangle, Lunge, Trip, Wound

Expert Perk
When hit with a melee weapon attack, as a reaction you can make a Disarm or Entangle attack against that enemy. As an object interaction, you can hook or unhook two hook swords. Hooked together, the weapons lose Light and gain Reach and Versatile d8, and count as one weapon.
tiers: Untrained Awkward, One-Handed, Melee d6
Basic One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d6, Disarm, Trip, Wound
Expert One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d6, Disarm, Entangle, Lunge, Trip, Wound
equipment.expertPerk: When hit with a melee weapon attack, as a reaction you can make a Disarm or Entangle attack against that enemy. As an object interaction, you can hook or unhook two hook swords. Hooked together, the weapons lose Light and gain Reach and Versatile d8, and count as one weapon.

equipment.name: Kama
equipment.description:
##### Kama

_Piercing and Slashing, 1 lb, 2 gp_

A small farm scythe with a straighter blade. A kama grants advantage on any ability check made to climb. A expert with the kama slides the blades together with a scissoring slice.

Untrained One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d4, Thrown (20/60)

Basic One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d4, Thrown (20/60), Keen, Nimble

Expert One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d4, Thrown (30/60), Entangle, Keen, Nimble, Trip

Expert Perk
Your Keen damage adds two total damage dice, instead of the usual one extra damage dice. If a kama is in the off-hand, you can use this bonus on your main hand weapon's Keen property.
tiers: Untrained One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d4, Thrown (20/60)
Basic One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d4, Thrown (20/60), Keen, Nimble
Expert One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d4, Thrown (30/60), Entangle, Keen, Nimble, Trip
equipment.expertPerk: Your Keen damage adds two total damage dice, instead of the usual one extra damage dice. If a kama is in the off-hand, you can use this bonus on your main hand weapon's Keen property.

equipment.name: Palm Axe
equipment.description:
##### Palm Axe

_Piercing or Slashing, 6 lbs, 45 gp_

An ancient Egyptian weapon styled after a palm frond used for fanning, this pole weapon has a crescent shaped blade mounted with the crescent points pointed down. The strikes of this axe can hit multiple foes in one swing, and the expert has found great success with this weapon's sweeping cuts.

Untrained Awkward, Two-Handed, Heavy, Reach, Melee d10, Brace, Keen, Puncture

Basic Two-Handed, Heavy, Reach, Melee 2d6, Brace, Keen, Puncture, Trip

Expert Two-Handed, Heavy, Reach, Melee 2d6, Brace, Deflect, Keen, Puncture, Trip

Expert Perk
As an action, you make an attack against each creature of your choice within range, and all ranged weapon attacks suffer disadvantage against you until the start of your next turn.
tiers: Untrained Awkward, Two-Handed, Heavy, Reach, Melee d10, Brace, Keen, Puncture
Basic Two-Handed, Heavy, Reach, Melee 2d6, Brace, Keen, Puncture, Trip
Expert Two-Handed, Heavy, Reach, Melee 2d6, Brace, Deflect, Keen, Puncture, Trip
equipment.expertPerk: As an action, you make an attack against each creature of your choice within range, and all ranged weapon attacks suffer disadvantage against you until the start of your next turn.

equipment.name: Poleaxe
equipment.description:
##### Poleaxe

_Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing, 7 lbs, 40 gp_

An iron-shod long weapon designed for armored foes, built with an axe, hammer, and a spike from the top. Though not long enough for reach, a expert's quarterstaff style makes it very defensive.

Untrained Awkward, Two-Handed, Heavy, Melee d10, Puncture, Stagger

Basic Two-Handed, Heavy, Melee d10, Brace, Deflect, Punch, Puncture, Stagger, Trip

Expert Two-Handed, Heavy, Melee 2d6, Brace, Deflect, Punch, Puncture, Stagger, Trip

Expert Perk
You gain +1 Weapon AC and you can add your proficiency bonus to Deflect rolls.
tiers: Untrained Awkward, Two-Handed, Heavy, Melee d10, Puncture, Stagger
Basic Two-Handed, Heavy, Melee d10, Brace, Deflect, Punch, Puncture, Stagger, Trip
Expert Two-Handed, Heavy, Melee 2d6, Brace, Deflect, Punch, Puncture, Stagger, Trip
equipment.expertPerk: You gain +1 Weapon AC and you can add your proficiency bonus to Deflect rolls.

equipment.name: Tomahawk
equipment.description:
##### Tomahawk

_Piercing or Slashing, 1 lb, 1 gp_

Also called a fransisca, this small axe features a hollow blade more balanced for throwing. The expert throws with force enough to drive the thinner axe head into a target and throw them off balance.

Untrained One-Handed, Melee d4, Thrown (10/30), Slip

Basic One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d4, Thrown (40/120), Slip, Trip

Expert One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d4, Thrown (40/120), Disarm, Slip, Trip

Expert Perk
If you score a mighty blow, your enemy has disadvantage on its next attack roll.
tiers: Untrained One-Handed, Melee d4, Thrown (10/30), Slip
Basic One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d4, Thrown (40/120), Slip, Trip
Expert One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d4, Thrown (40/120), Disarm, Slip, Trip
equipment.expertPerk: If you score a mighty blow, your enemy has disadvantage on its next attack roll.

equipment.name: Bar Mace
equipment.description:
##### Bar Mace

_Bludgeoning and Slashing, or Piercing, 3 lbs, 3 gp_

A stout, arm length iron bar lined with spikes or flanges, more able to utilize prying leverage to deal with armored foes. Designed for low skilled military soldiers, a expert uses the many angles to pry weapons from the enemy's hands.

Untrained Two-Handed, Melee d6, Disarm

Basic One-Handed, Melee d8, Disarm

Expert One-Handed, Melee d8, Deflect, Disarm

Expert Perk
On a powerful blow, you can deal damage equal to your Strength modifier, and force your enemy to suffer disadvantage to attacks. At the end of their turn they can roll a Constitution saving throw, ending this penalty on success.
tiers: Untrained Two-Handed, Melee d6, Disarm
Basic One-Handed, Melee d8, Disarm
Expert One-Handed, Melee d8, Deflect, Disarm
equipment.expertPerk: On a powerful blow, you can deal damage equal to your Strength modifier, and force your enemy to suffer disadvantage to attacks. At the end of their turn they can roll a Constitution saving throw, ending this penalty on success.

equipment.name: Bo Staff
equipment.description:
##### Bo Staff

_Bludgeoning, 2 lbs, 3sp_

The Japanese bo is a shorter, thinner quarterstaff, designed for a faster fighting style of quick strikes and acrobatic lunges. The expert is a flurry of spinning acrobatics and blocks.

Untrained Two-Handed, Finesse, Melee d6

Basic Two-Handed, Finesse, Melee d6, Double Ended d4, Trip

Expert Two-Handed, Finesse, Melee d6, Double Ended d6, Lunge, Deflect, Trip

Expert Perk
If you have the Extra Attack feature, you can make two attacks instead of one when you use this weapon's Double Ended property or when you make an opportunity attack.
tiers: Untrained Two-Handed, Finesse, Melee d6
Basic Two-Handed, Finesse, Melee d6, Double Ended d4, Trip
Expert Two-Handed, Finesse, Melee d6, Double Ended d6, Lunge, Deflect, Trip
equipment.expertPerk: If you have the Extra Attack feature, you can make two attacks instead of one when you use this weapon's Double Ended property or when you make an opportunity attack.

equipment.name: Flanged Mace
equipment.description:
##### Flanged Mace

_Bludgeoning and Slashing, 4 lbs, 5 gp_

A metal head with bladed protrusions, attached to a simple shaft designed specifically to hammer and shred armor. Experts punch through any armor to damage foes with ease.

Untrained One-Handed, Melee d6, Sunder

Basic One-Handed, Melee d6, Punch, Sunder

Expert One-Handed, Melee 2d4, Punch, Sunder

Expert Perk
Sunder always reduces AC by 2. If you score a powerful blow, your weapon Sunders automatically.
tiers: Untrained One-Handed, Melee d6, Sunder
Basic One-Handed, Melee d6, Punch, Sunder
Expert One-Handed, Melee 2d4, Punch, Sunder
equipment.expertPerk: Sunder always reduces AC by 2. If you score a powerful blow, your weapon Sunders automatically.

equipment.name: Greatclub
equipment.description:
##### Greatclub

_Bludgeoning, 8 lbs, 2sp_

A heavy, two-handed club. It can be refined like the Japanese Tetsubo with 5 gp to its cost, and the weapon gains Sunder. A expert can render a weapon nearly useless by smashing it bent or broken.

Untrained Two-Handed, Heavy, Melee d8, Stagger

Basic Two-Handed, Heavy, Melee d8, Disarm, Punch, Stagger

Expert Two-Handed, Heavy, Melee d10, Disarm, Knockback, Punch, Stagger

Expert Perk
If you score a mighty blow, your enemy must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or their mundane weapon suffers a permanent disadvantage on attack rolls until it is repaired.
tiers: Untrained Two-Handed, Heavy, Melee d8, Stagger
Basic Two-Handed, Heavy, Melee d8, Disarm, Punch, Stagger
Expert Two-Handed, Heavy, Melee d10, Disarm, Knockback, Punch, Stagger
equipment.expertPerk: If you score a mighty blow, your enemy must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or their mundane weapon suffers a permanent disadvantage on attack rolls until it is repaired.

equipment.name: Heavy Club
equipment.description:
##### Heavy Club

_Bludgeoning, 3 lbs, 1sp_

A larger mass weapon, much like a bat or ball mace. An expert can target the foe's head more easily, disorienting and disabling their foes with a wound-up swing for the fences.

Untrained Two-Handed, Melee d6

Basic One-Handed, Melee d6, Versatile 2d4, Thrown (20/40)

##### Grapple Crossbow

_Piercing and Slashing, 13 lbs, 175 gp_

This heavy crossbow has a coiled silk rope and a self winding mechanism that shoots a small pointed hook which can even pierce into ceilings. Once the mechanism is engaged, it winds the rope back up, allowing the user to ascend with the bow at a rate of 60 ft per round. It can lift 500 lbs in total, but anything beyond this weight, the mechanism simply holds the rope taut.

When entangling an enemy, you can engage the mechanism as an object interaction, forcing the enemy to succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pulled toward you. However, if it succeeds, you are pulled toward the enemy unless you let go of your grapple crossbow or use an object interaction to disengage the mechanism.

_Bludgeoning or Piercing, 8 lbs, 25 gp_

A pronged hammer on one side and a vicious hooking spike on the other side of a pole mount. Lucerne experts  swing at angles which force their enemies to choose between sacrificing equipment or flesh.

equipment.description:

_Bludgeoning, 12 lbs, 10 gp_

A massive hammer, the maul can send foes staggering from even attempting to block. You gain advantage when rolling an attack to destroy objects. The expert can bully their opponents with the weight of this massive weapon.

_Piercing, 1 lb, 5 gp_

A thin, round spike and round cross section makes a perfect sidearm for punching through armor. A expert employs quick grappling techniques and holds.

equipment.description:
##### Wall Pick

_Piercing, 1 lbs, 3 gp_

A climbing axe built sturdy for war. This weapon's Entangle property can only be used when making a melee attack. A wall pick gives you advantage on any ability checks made to climb. The expert can easily grapple with climbing skill.

Expert One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d6, Thrown (20/60), Barbed, Disarm, Entangle, Punch, Trip, Wound

If your Entangle misses, you can reroll the attack but must take the new roll. If you score a powerful blow, your enemy is restrained and grappled.

equipment.description:
##### War Hammer

_Bludgeoning or Piercing, 3 lbs, 15 gp_

Historically a lightweight, long-handled weapon designed to punch through and ruin armor with a small pronged hammer head, backed with a military pick. A expert of the warhammer carries momentum into each attack.

_Bludgeoning, 4lb, 20 gp_

An maul head mounted to a short handle, the war mallet expert finds the compact weight can be targeted at an enemy's weak points, causing them to fail when they otherwise wouldn't.

_Piercing, 2 lbs, 15 gp_

A weaponized miner's pick for use against armored infantries. The expert can strike vital areas, puncturing deeply to bleed the target out over time.

Expert One-Handed, Melee d10, Punch, Puncture, Sunder, Trip, Wound

equipment.name: Atlatl
equipment.description:
##### Atlatl

_Piercing, 1 lb, 1 gp_

A small hooked handle whereupon a javelin or great arrow is laid into a groove similar to a crossbow tiller. The user launches the weapon in a striking motion, letting the arrow fly as they fling the weapon forward, compounding two motions to get the power and range greater than a throw.

Basic One-Handed, Ranged d8 (100/300), Reload (Object interaction), Punch

Expert One-Handed, Ranged d10 (100/300), Reload (Free), Punch, Puncture

equipment.name: Blowgun
equipment.description:
##### Blowgun

_Piercing, 1 lb, 1 gp_

A tube used to launch a needle dart with your breath. The dart is small and silent, and if you make an attack from stealth and miss, your location is not revealed. A expert uses the art of the flying viper, shooting two darts at once and reloading with a single hand.

Untrained One-Handed, Ranged 1 damage (25/50), Reload (Free), Conceal, Hipshot

Basic Light, One-Handed, Ranged d4 (25/100), Reload (Free), Conceal, Hipshot

Expert Light, One-Handed, Ranged d4 (50/100), Reload (Free), Conceal, Hipshot

Expert Perk
You can load two darts and shoot two with the same attack roll at the same target or to two targets that are within 5 feet of one another. Each dart can deliver a poison or other payload, and when this weapon delivers poison, the enemy suffers disadvantage on the saving throw. Apply your ability modifier to damage on only one dart.
tiers: Untrained One-Handed, Ranged 1 damage (25/50), Reload (Free), Conceal, Hipshot

equipment.name: Portable Catapult
equipment.description:
##### Portable Catapult

_Bludgeoning, 20lb, 175g_

This small thrower is worn like a backpack with the launcher arm under rope torsion on its axle, and the bucket straight up, just behind the user's head. Two ropes sit on pulleys located at your hip, and you pull the ropes to wind the arm back, then release. This weapon requires 13 Strength to wield it, but you can add half your Strength modifier to damage in addition to your normal ability modifier. A expert dumps a container of ammunition into the basket for a deadly volley at range.

Untrained Awkward, Two-Handed, Affixed, Heavy, Ranged 2d8, (75/400), Reload (Action), Knockback

Basic Two-Handed, Affixed, Heavy, Ranged 2d8 (150/600), Reload (Attack), Knockback, Punch, Stagger, Trip

Expert Two-Handed, Affixed, Heavy, Ranged 2d10 (150/600), Reload (Bonus), Hipshot, Knockback, Punch, Stagger, Trip

Expert Perk
You can load a full container of ammunition, e.g. 20 arrows or 50 needles, into the basket. As an action, you pick a point in range and release the basket. Each creature within a 20 ft radius cylinder, 60ft high centered on your point must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking a number of weapon damage dice in damage equal to your proficiency bonus on a failed save, or half on a success.

equipment.name: Rope Dart
equipment.description:
##### Rope Dart

_Piercing, 5 lbs, 10 gp_

A small dart on the end of a silk rope, this weapon requires extensive training to get full use out of. After each launch, the user can return the weapon to their hand for free, and the Brace attack can be a ranged attack. The expert has perfected this coiled execution, releasing the weapon for a variety of hindering attacks as an enemy rushes them.

Untrained Awkward, Two-Handed, Ranged d4 (10/50), Conceal, Hipshot

Basic Two-Handed, Ranged d4 (20/50), Brace, Conceal, Entangle, Hipshot, Puncture

Expert Two-Handed, Ranged d4 (50/50), Brace, Conceal, Disarm, Entangle, Hipshot, Puncture, Trip

Expert Perk
You can Brace as a bonus action and make a number of Brace attacks without using your reaction equal to your proficiency bonus before the start of your next turn.

equipment.name: Sling
equipment.description:
##### Sling

_Bludgeoning, 0.1 lbs, 1sp_

A simple leather cup swung about the body. You can launch anything that can fit in the cup; bombs, potions, poisons, even rounded stones. You can make a melee attack with it loaded, swinging the weapon like a flail. This weapon's entangle property may only be used in melee. A expert maximizes their power in the throw with precise shots to the head.

Untrained One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Ranged d8 (60/400), Reload (Object Interaction), Conceal

Basic One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d4, Ranged d8 (150/600), Reload (Free), Conceal, Disarm

Expert One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d6, Ranged d10 (150/600), Reload (Free), Conceal, Disarm, Entangle, Trip

Expert Perk
On a mighty blow, the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or suffer disadvantage to attacks until the end of its next turn.

equipment.name: Sling Staff
equipment.description:
##### Sling Staff

_Bludgeoning, 4 lbs, 2 gp_

A sling mounted on a quarterstaff, the user can both launch bullets like the sling, and use the sling's rope in unique ways combined with the staff. The expert can entangle a target and still effectively pummel their foe.

Untrained Two-Handed, Melee d6, Ranged d6 (60/400), Reload (Object interaction)

Basic Two-Handed, Melee d6, Ranged d6 (150/600), Reload (Free), Double Ended d8, Entangle

Expert Two-Handed, Melee d8, Ranged 2d4 (150/600), Reload (Free), Double Ended d10, Disarm, Entangle, Trip

Your Double Ended attacks deal weapon damage plus your Strength modifier to your grappled target, and still automatically hit.

equipment.name: Sling Tube
equipment.description:
##### Sling Tube

_Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing, 2 lbs, 10 gp_

A tube with a cup or stopper at the end facing the user, attached to a thin rope which rises out of the front of the weapon. The user pulls the rope to launch whatever is in the tube. A sling tube can launch any reasonably thin ammunition, from great arrows and javelins to arrows and bolts, to sling bullets.

Untrained Two-Handed, Ranged d6 (30/90), Reload (Bonus), Conceal, Hipshot

Basic Two-Handed, Ranged d6 (60/180), Reload (Object Interaction), Conceal, Hipshot

Expert Two-Handed, Ranged d8 (60/180), Reload (Free), Conceal, Hipshot

Expert Perk
You can pack up to a full container of ammunition, e.g. 20 arrows or 50 needles, into the sling tube. As an action, you can launch all the ammunition in a 30 foot cone. Each creature in the cone must take a Dexterity saving throw. A target takes a number of weapon dice damage equal to your proficiency bonus on a failed save, or none on a success.

equipment.name: Wrist Shot
equipment.description:
##### Wrist Shot

_Bludgeoning, 1 lb, 5 gp_

Instead of gathering circular momentum, this slingshot uses elastic material to launch anything a sling can without the penalty. A wrist shot is a favorite of smaller folk, more easily able to conceal the weapon and able to make use of ranged attacks with smaller arms and generally weaker stature. experts with wrist shots can target weak points and make it easier for their allies to land critical blows.

Untrained Two-Handed, Ranged d4 (40/160), Conceal, Hipshot

Basic Two-Handed, Ranged d4 (40/160), Conceal, Disarm, Hipshot

Expert Two-Handed, Ranged d6 (40/160), Conceal, Disarm, Hipshot, Stagger

Expert Perk
When you score a mighty blow, your enemy loses its reaction until the start of its next turn. If you score a powerful blow, this effect applies, as well as all attacks against this enemy gain advantage until the end of your next turn. On a critical hit, these effects both apply.

equipment.name: Bite
equipment.description:
##### Bite

_Piercing_

If you are at least two size categories bigger than your target, you can force your target to succeed on a Dexterity or Strength saving throw or become grappled with any attack. This listing can be used for any other attack which originates from the mouth, e.g mandibles, beaks, maw, etc. A bite is counted as a two-handed weapon.

Proficient Finesse, Natural, Melee, Entangle, Nimble, Wound

Expert Finesse, Natural, Melee, Barbed, Entangle, Nimble, Wound

Expert Perk
When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can make a single bite attack as part of that action.
tiers: Proficient Finesse, Natural, Melee, Entangle, Nimble, Wound
Expert Finesse, Natural, Melee, Barbed, Entangle, Nimble, Wound
equipment.expertPerk: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can make a single bite attack as part of that action.

equipment.name: Claw
equipment.description:
##### Claw

_Piercing or Slashing_

This listing can be used for any other Natural weapons which are at the end of an appendage, e.g. pincers, talons, impale, etc. If your claws are retractable, you gain the Conceal property. A claw is counted as a one-handed weapon.

Proficient Finesse, Natural, Melee, Keen, Nimble, Wound

Expert Finesse, Light, Natural, Melee, Keen, Nimble, Wound

Expert Perk
When you take the Attack action and hit with a melee attack, you can count that attack as a critical hit. Once you use this ability you cannot do so again until you finish a short rest.
tiers: Proficient Finesse, Natural, Melee, Keen, Nimble, Wound
Expert Finesse, Light, Natural, Melee, Keen, Nimble, Wound
equipment.expertPerk: When you take the Attack action and hit with a melee attack, you can count that attack as a critical hit. Once you use this ability you cannot do so again until you finish a short rest.

equipment.name: Horns
equipment.description:
##### Horns

_Bludgeoning and Piercing_

If you are at least two size categories bigger than your target, any attack deals normal damage and you can force your target to succeed on a Dexterity or Strength saving throw or be pushed 5 feet away from you. This listing can be used for any attack which is of a similar source, e.g. spike, gore, ram, etc. Horns are counted as a two-handed weapon.

Proficient Natural, Melee, Brace, Punch, Puncture, Sunder

Expert Natural, Melee, Brace, Deflect, Punch, Puncture, Sunder

Expert Perk
When you move at least 20 feet in a straight line toward your target, you can make one melee attack with your horns as a bonus action. If this attack hits, your weapon damage dice is doubled.
tiers: Proficient Natural, Melee, Brace, Punch, Puncture, Sunder
Expert Natural, Melee, Brace, Deflect, Punch, Puncture, Sunder
equipment.expertPerk: When you move at least 20 feet in a straight line toward your target, you can make one melee attack with your horns as a bonus action. If this attack hits, your weapon damage dice is doubled.

equipment.name: Slam
equipment.description:
##### Slam

_Bludgeoning_

Creatures lacking in predatory teeth and claws use their weight against a target. If you are two size categories larger than your target , your attack always applies the Stagger property. This listing can be used for any other blunt attack, e.g. hooves, fist, stomp, etc. Slam is counted as a two-handed weapon.

Proficient Heavy, Natural, Melee, Brace, Disarm, Stagger

Expert Heavy, Natural, Melee, Brace, Disarm, Knockback, Stagger

Expert Perk
If you move at least 20ft straight toward an enemy and hit with a slam attack in the same turn, that enemy must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be knocked prone and you can make an additional slam attack as a bonus action.
tiers: Proficient Heavy, Natural, Melee, Brace, Disarm, Stagger
Expert Heavy, Natural, Melee, Brace, Disarm, Knockback, Stagger
equipment.expertPerk: If you move at least 20ft straight toward an enemy and hit with a slam attack in the same turn, that enemy must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be knocked prone and you can make an additional slam attack as a bonus action.

equipment.name: Tail
equipment.description:
##### Tail

_Bludgeoning_

If you are at least two size categories bigger than your target, any attack deals normal damage and you can force your target to succeed on a Strength or Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone. Specifically non-prehensile tails used for sweeping or bludgeoning attacks should use this listing. Tail is counted as a one-handed weapon, though it can still use Double Ended.

Proficient Natural, Reach, Melee, Double Ended (one dice size smaller) Knockback, Trip

Expert Natural, Reach, Melee, Double Ended (same damage dice), Knockback, Stagger, Trip

Expert Perk
As an action, you can attack all enemies within 5 feet of you.
tiers: Proficient Natural, Reach, Melee, Double Ended (one dice size smaller) Knockback, Trip
Expert Natural, Reach, Melee, Double Ended (same damage dice), Knockback, Stagger, Trip
equipment.expertPerk: As an action, you can attack all enemies within 5 feet of you.

equipment.name: Tentacle
equipment.description:
##### Tentacle

_Bludgeoning or Piercing_

This listing can be used for any other tentacle-like or grasping appendage or attack, e.g. pseudopod, tendril, etc. When you Entangle with a tentacle, your enemy has disadvantage on the escape attempt. A tentacle is counted as a one-handed weapon.

Proficient Finesse, Light, Natural, Melee, Entangle, Trip

Expert Finesse, Light, Natural, Melee, Disarm, Entangle, Trip

Expert Perk
When your target fails a saving throw against your Entangle attack, they become restrained and grappled.
tiers: Proficient Finesse, Light, Natural, Melee, Entangle, Trip
Expert Finesse, Light, Natural, Melee, Disarm, Entangle, Trip
equipment.expertPerk: When your target fails a saving throw against your Entangle attack, they become restrained and grappled.

equipment.description:

_Bludgeoning_

Untrained unarmed strikes are simple punches while Proficient training teaches proper punches and kicks. However, a real expert of unarmed strikes is as well trained as a traditional monk. A expert's damage scales according to proficiency bonus on to the table below unless it is higher due to fighting style or racial trait. Unarmed strikes are counted as a one-handed weapon, but your unarmed strikes don't count as weapon attacks until you have expert training or have chosen the Unarmed Fighting style.

equipment.name: Wings
equipment.description:
##### Wings

_Bludgeoning_

While most wings are too delicate to be used as a weapon, they can be used in an emergency for defensive purposes. If your wings have no damage listing, they use Deflect d6, otherwise using the damage listed for the attack. Wings are counted as a two-handed weapon.

Proficient Finesse, Natural, Melee, Deflect d6, Knockback, Trip

Expert Finesse, Natural, Melee, Deflect d8, Knockback, Lunge, Trip

Expert Perk
As long as you do not already have disadvantage on your attack rolls, when you make your first attack on your turn, you can decide to attack defensively. Doing so gives you disadvantage on all weapon attack rolls during this turn, but attack rolls against you have disadvantage until your next turn
tiers: Proficient Finesse, Natural, Melee, Deflect d6, Knockback, Trip
Expert Finesse, Natural, Melee, Deflect d8, Knockback, Lunge, Trip
equipment.expertPerk: As long as you do not already have disadvantage on your attack rolls, when you make your first attack on your turn, you can decide to attack defensively. Doing so gives you disadvantage on all weapon attack rolls during this turn, but attack rolls against you have disadvantage until your next turn

equipment.name: Bladed Staff
equipment.description:
##### Bladed Staff

_Piercing or Slashing, 6 lbs, 100 gp_

A 6' staff weapon with a sword on each end, usually straight, but curved varieties exist. A bladed staff can be used to great effect, creating space around the wielder in a skirmish, or used as an effective spear with a wicked butt end. The expert is able to attack as quickly with two blades as others are with only one, in lightning rapid fire strikes that take full advantage of the weapon's reach.

Untrained Awkward, Two-Handed, Reach, Melee d8, Balanced

Proficient Two-Handed, Finesse, Reach, Melee 2d4, Double Ended d4, Balanced

Expert Two-Handed, Finesse, Reach, Melee 2d4, Double Ended 2d4, Balanced

Expert Perk
When you use the Double Ended property, you do not need to be within 5ft of your target.

Proficient Two-Handed, Finesse, Reach, Melee 2d4, Double Ended d4, Balanced
Expert Two-Handed, Finesse, Reach, Melee 2d4, Double Ended 2d4, Balanced
equipment.expertPerk: When you use the Double Ended property, you do not need to be within 5ft of your target.

equipment.name: Glaive
equipment.description:
##### Glaive

_Piercing or Slashing, 5 lbs, 20 gp_

Perhaps the simplest of the polearms, a glaive is a short sword blade mounted on a long pole, used like a spear or a greatsword, the wide, sweeping slashes become useful for dealing with enemies much bigger than the wielder. While originally designed to be used by infantry against cavalry, in the hands of a expert, a glaive is quite effective as a giant killer.

Untrained Awkward, Two-Handed, Finesse, Heavy, Reach, Melee d10, Brace

Proficient Two-Handed, Finesse, Heavy, Reach, Melee 2d6, Balanced, Brace

Expert Two-Handed, Finesse, Heavy, Reach, Melee 2d6, Balanced, Brace, Lunge, Stagger

Expert Perk
Against creatures of category size Large and larger, your damage is 3d6 instead of 2d6. Your Double Ended attack becomes 2d4.
tiers: Untrained Awkward, Two-Handed, Finesse, Heavy, Reach, Melee d10, Brace
Proficient Two-Handed, Finesse, Heavy, Reach, Melee 2d6, Balanced, Brace
Expert Two-Handed, Finesse, Heavy, Reach, Melee 2d6, Balanced, Brace, Lunge, Stagger
equipment.expertPerk: Against creatures of category size Large and larger, your damage is 3d6 instead of 2d6. Your Double Ended attack becomes 2d4.

equipment.name: Guisarme
equipment.description:
##### Guisarme

_Piercing or Slashing, 5 lbs, 20 gp_

A sharpened and sturdy pruning hook, developed as a peasant weapon from modifying a farm tool. The curved hook of the blade allows the guisarme to be used as a tripping weapon or to pull foes from the saddle. A guisarme is a favorite of common militias who will face cavalry in battle, as the expert can pull a knight from the saddle with relative ease.

Untrained Two-Handed, Heavy, Reach, Melee d10, Brace, Trip

Proficient Two-Handed, Heavy, Reach, Melee d12, Brace, Entangle, Trip

Expert Two handed, Heavy, Reach, Melee 2d6, Barbed, Brace, Entangle, Trip

Expert Perk
Your trip attacks impose disadvantage on saving throws made against them and if you succeed on a trip attack against a mounted enemy, it is automatically dismounted and lands prone in an unoccupied space of your choice within 5ft of its mount.

equipment.expertPerk: Your trip attacks impose disadvantage on saving throws made against them and if you succeed on a trip attack against a mounted enemy, it is automatically dismounted and lands prone in an unoccupied space of your choice within 5ft of its mount.

equipment.name: Lajatang
equipment.description:
##### Lajatang

_Piercing or Slashing, 8 lbs, 75 gp_

A rare and unusual double ended weapon, consisting of a 3-5ft shaft and a crescent blade fitted at each end, with the points of the crescents pointing away from the haft of the weapon, giving it essentially 2 outward facing spear points on each end. Lajatang experts are extremely rare, but are a whirling dervish of crescent blades and points, dangerous from all sides.

UntrainedAwkward, Two-Handed, Heavy, Reach, Melee d6, Brace

Proficient Two-Handed, Finesse, Heavy, Reach, Melee d10, Double Ended d10, Brace

Expert Two-Handed, Finesse, Heavy, Reach, Melee d12, Double Ended d12, Brace

Expert Perk
On your turn, you can spend your reaction to enter a Defensive Stance, negating any flanking bonus or ability any enemy might have for flanking you or having the enemy's ally near you, such as pack tactics or sneak attack. You can use Double Ended twice on your turn, but your second attack must be against a different target than your first.

equipment.name: Naginata
equipment.description:
##### Naginata

_Piercing or Slashing, 4 lbs, 25 gp_

A glaive-like weapon with a curved blade similar to a katana. The light polearm is best used in the hands of a expert that can leverage its speed and balance.

Untrained Awkward, Two-Handed, Finesse, Reach, Melee d10, Keen

Proficient Two-Handed, Finesse, Reach, Melee 2d6, Balanced, Keen

Expert Two-Handed, Finesse, Reach, Melee 2d6, Balanced, Deflect, Keen, Lunge

Expert Perk
You can add your proficiency bonus to your Deflect roll.

Expert Two-Handed, Finesse, Reach, Melee 2d6, Balanced, Deflect, Keen, Lunge

equipment.name: Partisan
equipment.description:
##### Partisan

_Piercing or Slashing, 6 lbs, 25 gp_

Much like a Glaive design, this pole weapon is essentially a shortsword blade mounted to a long haft, but keeps a wide cross guard at the base of the blade, trading sweeping cuts for defensive guards. The expert Partisan uses the guard of their weapon like a shield at distance, and can even use it to protect allies.

Untrained Awkward, Heavy, Reach, Two-Handed, Melee d10, Brace

Proficient Two-Handed, Heavy, Reach, Melee 2d6, Brace, Deflect, Riposte

Expert Two-Handed, Heavy, Reach, Melee 2d6, Brace, Deflect, Lunge, Riposte

Expert Perk
You have +1 weapon AC. When an enemy lands an attack on an ally within your range, you can use your reaction to force the enemy to reroll the attack.
tiers: Untrained Awkward, Heavy, Reach, Two-Handed, Melee d10, Brace
Proficient Two-Handed, Heavy, Reach, Melee 2d6, Brace, Deflect, Riposte
Expert Two-Handed, Heavy, Reach, Melee 2d6, Brace, Deflect, Lunge, Riposte
equipment.expertPerk: You have +1 weapon AC. When an enemy lands an attack on an ally within your range, you can use your reaction to force the enemy to reroll the attack.

equipment.name: War Scythe
equipment.description:
##### War Scythe

_Piercing or Slashing, 8 lbs, 5 gp_

Whether mounted horizontally like a traditional farming implement, or mounted vertically like a glaive, a war scythe has its roots in a peasant militia looking to arm itself in times of war. A scythe in the right hands can be useful in combat, though it takes a practiced expert to be truly effective. The expert uses the scythe's reaping motion to carry its cleaving momentum into the next foe.

Untrained Two-Handed, Heavy, Reach, Melee d8, Keen, Puncture, Trip

Proficient Two-Handed, Heavy, Reach, Melee 2d4, Entangle, Keen, Puncture, Trip

Expert Two-Handed, Heavy, Reach, Melee 2d6, Entangle, Keen, Puncture, Sunder, Trip

Expert Perk
When you reduce an enemy to 0 hit points, you can choose to apply the remaining damage to any other target within your range, instead of only adjacent targets.
tiers: Untrained Two-Handed, Heavy, Reach, Melee d8, Keen, Puncture, Trip
Proficient Two-Handed, Heavy, Reach, Melee 2d4, Entangle, Keen, Puncture, Trip
Expert Two-Handed, Heavy, Reach, Melee 2d6, Entangle, Keen, Puncture, Sunder, Trip
equipment.expertPerk: When you reduce an enemy to 0 hit points, you can choose to apply the remaining damage to any other target within your range, instead of only adjacent targets.

equipment.name: Skirmish
equipment.description:
##### Skirmish

_+2 AC, 6 lbs, 10 gp_
Skirmish shields come in a variety of shapes but are about the size of the user's torso. A Skirmish shield is large enough to provide better passive protection than the buckler, while still providing the agility missing with a tower shield. The expert can extend this agility to even spell attacks and can offensively use the edge of their shield.

Basic You gain an additional +2AC bonus against ranged weapon attacks, adding +4AC in total.

Expert You gain an additional +2AC bonus against ranged spell attacks, adding +4 in total, and a successful shove deals d4 + Strength modifier in bludgeoning damage.
tiers: Basic You gain an additional +2AC bonus against ranged weapon attacks, adding +4AC in total.
Expert You gain an additional +2AC bonus against ranged spell attacks, adding +4 in total, and a successful shove deals d4 + Strength modifier in bludgeoning damage.

equipment.name: Arm Guard
equipment.description:
##### Arm Guard

_+1 AC, 1 lb, 10 gp_

A fully enclosed arm shield that often had a sword built into its construction to make a gauntlet sword called a pata.

Without an attached weapon, the hand which has an arm guard equipped can be used to help wield a weapon or assist with Reload, but cannot be used to wield a weapon by itself; in this case it must be attached to the arm guard. The expert has perfected this fighting style.

Basic You can attach a Light weapon to an arm guard using smith's tools over the course of 8 hours of work. The weapon gains the Affixed property but can't be removed from the shield without smith's tools When removed, the weapon is destroyed. Attack rolls made with any arm guard hand suffer a -1 penalty.

Expert You no longer suffer an attack penalty, you cannot be disarmed, and you can don the arm guard for free.
tiers: Basic You can attach a Light weapon to an arm guard using smith's tools over the course of 8 hours of work. The weapon gains the Affixed property but can't be removed from the shield without smith's tools When removed, the weapon is destroyed. Attack rolls made with any arm guard hand suffer a -1 penalty.
Expert You no longer suffer an attack penalty, you cannot be disarmed, and you can don the arm guard for free.

equipment.name: Buckler
equipment.description:
##### Buckler

_+1 AC, 2 lbs, 5 gp_

A buckler, or target, is a hand shield used by duelists and fencers for its small profile and ease of counter attacks while deflecting. The expert's trained duelist techniques set them up for the perfect riposte.

Basic The buckler has Finesse and Deflect (d8)

Expert You can add the Deflect roll from the buckler to any Deflect roll you make with your main hand, and if this roll reduces incoming damage to 0, you can make an attack against the triggering creature as part of the same reaction.
tiers: Basic The buckler has Finesse and Deflect (d8)

Expert You can add the Deflect roll from the buckler to any Deflect roll you make with your main hand, and if this roll reduces incoming damage to 0, you can make an attack against the triggering creature as part of the same reaction.

equipment.name: Diskarmor
equipment.description:
##### Diskarmor

_+2 AC, 8 lbs, 50 gp_

An esoteric weapon of gnomish invention, a diskarmor is a round shield attached to a chain mechanism that retracts quickly after the chain reaches its length to make essentially a shield yo-yo. The user can toss it out to wield it like a large flail, then retract it to be used as a shield again.

Diskarmor is a shield which has the following properties:

One-Handed, Reach, Melee d6, Clockwork, Entangle, Trip.

Diskarmor deals bludgeoning damage. A diskarmor is not considered a weapon.

Basic You can replace any of your attacks with an attack using the Diskarmor. This attack does not benefit from your ability modifier to damage unless you have the Two-Weapon Fighting Style.

Expert When your ally within 10ft is hit by an attack, you can use your reaction to confer your shield AC bonus from this shield to them until the end of your next turn, possibly negating an attack.
tiers: Basic You can replace any of your attacks with an attack using the Diskarmor. This attack does not benefit from your ability modifier to damage unless you have the Two-Weapon Fighting Style.
Expert When your ally within 10ft is hit by an attack, you can use your reaction to confer your shield AC bonus from this shield to them until the end of your next turn, possibly negating an attack.

equipment.name: Kite
equipment.description:
##### Kite

_+3 AC, 10 lbs, 50 gp_

Kite shields are as wide as the wielder's torso but extend downward with a point or oval extension to protect the legs, which can also be used offensively to knock an enemy off guard. While wielding a Kite, you only add a maximum of + to your AC from your Dexterity modifier.

Basic You gain advantage on any saving throw or ability check made to resist being knocked prone or moved along the ground.

Expert When you win an Athletics contest against an enemy within 5ft, you can Stagger your enemy in addition to winning the contest.
tiers: Basic You gain advantage on any saving throw or ability check made to resist being knocked prone or moved along the ground.
Expert When you win an Athletics contest against an enemy within 5ft, you can Stagger your enemy in addition to winning the contest.

equipment.name: Pavise
equipment.description:
##### Pavise

_+1 AC, 15 lbs, 35 gp_

A pavise is a lighter tower shield with a central spike to drive into the ground, or a set of legs to allow the shield to stand freely. While deployed, you can use it as cover. Unfortunately it is unwieldable as a normal shield, only able to be worn on the back. While wearing it, you are unable to equip any other shield, and only add a maximum of +2 from your Dexterity modifier to your AC, as its size is ungainly and cumbersome. While deployed, a Pavise can be knocked down if the enemy succeeds on an Athletics Check against your weapon DC. As a bonus action you can pick up a pavise and either deploy it again or don it on your back.

Basic While worn, you gain +1 AC and negate any flanking bonus any enemy might have on you. As a bonus action, you can deploy the shield to solid ground, which takes up a 5 ft square space. While the shield is between you and any enemy, you gain the benefits of half cover.

Expert While the shield is between you and any enemy, you gain the benefits of three-quarters cover. Additionally, an enemy has disadvantage on any roll made to knock your shield down while you use it as cover.
tiers: Basic While worn, you gain +1 AC and negate any flanking bonus any enemy might have on you. As a bonus action, you can deploy the shield to solid ground, which takes up a 5 ft square space. While the shield is between you and any enemy, you gain the benefits of half cover.

Expert While the shield is between you and any enemy, you gain the benefits of three-quarters cover. Additionally, an enemy has disadvantage on any roll made to knock your shield down while you use it as cover.

equipment.name: Spiked
equipment.description:
##### Spiked

_+2 AC, 8 lbs, 20 gp_

A spiked shield is a blanket term for all weaponized shields, with spikes on the face and either a spiked or bladed edge. Somewhat cumbersome compared to a skirmish shield with the added weaponization, a spiked shield is hard to be stealthy and agile with.

Spiked shield is a shield which has the following properties: One-Handed, Melee d6, Brace, Puncture, Thrown (20/60). Spiked shield deals piercing or slashing damage. A spiked shield is not considered a weapon.

Basic You can replace any of your attacks with an attack using the Spiked shield. This attack does not benefit from your ability modifier to damage unless you have the Two-Weapon Fighting Style.

Expert You are so effective at using the dangerous points or blades of your shield that all enemies suffer disadvantage to Athletics checks against you, and a successful shove deals d4 + Strength modifier in piercing or slashing damage.
tiers: Basic You can replace any of your attacks with an attack using the Spiked shield. This attack does not benefit from your ability modifier to damage unless you have the Two-Weapon Fighting Style.

Expert You are so effective at using the dangerous points or blades of your shield that all enemies suffer disadvantage to Athletics checks against you, and a successful shove deals d4 + Strength modifier in piercing or slashing damage.

equipment.name: Tower
equipment.description:
##### Tower

_+3 AC, 20 lbs, 50 gp_

This massive shield is as tall as you and just as wide; you more fight around it like a door as a piece of mobile cover. The expert shieldman can take cover at a moment's notice, effectively giving the enemy no target. While wielding a tower shield, you cannot add your Dexterity modifier to your AC.

Basic You negate any flanking bonus an enemy might have on you. Additionally, when you are hit with an attack or are forced to roll a Dexterity saving throw, you can use your reaction to gain half cover, possibly negating the attack or granting you a bonus to your Dexterity saving throw before you roll. This half cover lasts only for the effect that triggered your reaction.

Expert While using the shield as cover, if you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw, and you fail that save, you take only half damage.
tiers: Basic You negate any flanking bonus an enemy might have on you. Additionally, when you are hit with an attack or are forced to roll a Dexterity saving throw, you can use your reaction to gain half cover, possibly negating the attack or granting you a bonus to your Dexterity saving throw before you roll. This half cover lasts only for the effect that triggered your reaction.
Expert While using the shield as cover, if you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw, and you fail that save, you take only half damage.

equipment.name: Godendag
equipment.description:
##### Godendag

_Bludgeoning or Piercing, 5 lbs, 12 gp_

A short spear with a heavy ball or weight to hold the spear point, making use of sweeping bludgeons and weighted piercing attacks. The expert makes full use of the added weight for powerful blows that set their enemy off balance.

Untrained Awkward, Two-Handed, Melee d6, Thrown (10/40), Punch, Puncture, Stagger

Proficient Two-Handed, Melee d6, Thrown (20/60), Punch, Puncture, , Stagger, Trip

Expert Two-Handed, Melee d8, Thrown (30/120), Disarm, Punch, Puncture, Stagger, Trip

Expert Perk
If you score a mighty blow, the next attack against this target gains advantage.

Proficient Two-Handed, Melee d6, Thrown (20/60), Punch, Puncture, , Stagger, Trip

equipment.name: Harpoon
equipment.description:
##### Harpoon

_Piercing, 6 lbs, 11 gp_

A barbed throwing spear attached to a 50ft length of silk rope so the target can be pulled toward you. On a hit, your enemy must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be impaled, while a critical hit always impales. A expert of the harpoon impales with ease and can swiftly reel in a harpooned prey.

As a bonus action, make a contested Athletics check against the impaled creature. On a success, you drag it toward you up to a number of feet equal to your Strength score. On its turn, it follows this same rule to pull away from you. Creatures two or more size categories larger than you cause you to move with them while you hold the rope. 

While impaled, the enemy suffers the Wound property. The creature can use its action to make a Strength saving throw, pulling the weapon free on a success.

UntrainedAwkward, One-Handed, Melee d6, Thrown (10/40), Wound

Proficient One-Handed, Melee d6, Thrown (20/60), Barbed, Puncture, Wound

Expert One-Handed, Light, Melee d8, Thrown (30/120), Barbed, Punch, Puncture, Wound

Expert Perk
You drag an enemy toward you a number of feet equal to twice your Strength score, and your target suffers disadvantage to Strength saving throws while it is impaled.
tiers: UntrainedAwkward, One-Handed, Melee d6, Thrown (10/40), Wound
Proficient One-Handed, Melee d6, Thrown (20/60), Barbed, Puncture, Wound
Expert One-Handed, Light, Melee d8, Thrown (30/120), Barbed, Punch, Puncture, Wound
equipment.expertPerk: You drag an enemy toward you a number of feet equal to twice your Strength score, and your target suffers disadvantage to Strength saving throws while it is impaled.

equipment.name: Hand Spear
equipment.description:
##### Hand Spear

_Piercing, 1 lbs, 2 gp_

A dagger-length hand spear called a siangham or emeici, it is similar in appearance to an arrow with a handle but which has a stabbing point on both ends. The expert uses this balanced weapon to attack in quick succession in close melee.

Untrained One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d4, Thrown (20/40), Puncture, Slip

Proficient One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d4, Thrown (20/40) Balanced, Puncture, Slip

Expert One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d4, Thrown (20/60) Balanced, Nimble, Puncture, Slip

Expert Perk
If you make a second attack on your turn against the same creature, that attack has advantage and you ignore all sources of disadvantage for that attack.
tiers: Untrained One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d4, Thrown (20/40), Puncture, Slip

Expert One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d4, Thrown (20/60) Balanced, Nimble, Puncture, Slip
equipment.expertPerk: If you make a second attack on your turn against the same creature, that attack has advantage and you ignore all sources of disadvantage for that attack.

equipment.name: Javelin
equipment.description:
##### Javelin

_Piercing, 1 lb, 1 gp_

A light throwing spear still sturdy enough to be used in melee. A expert can make an Olympian throw, forcing the enemy to pry the javelin free or suffer a major flaw in defense.

UntrainedOne-Handed, Finesse, Melee d6, Thrown (20/60), Punch

Proficient One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d6, Thrown (30/120), Punch

Expert One-Handed, Finesse, Light, Melee d8, Thrown (30/240), Punch, Sunder

Expert Perk
When you score a mighty blow, the target suffers a -2 AC penalty. On its turn an enemy can use an action to succeed on a Strength saving throw to pry the javelin free, destroying it in the process.

equipment.name: Lance
equipment.description:
##### Lance

_Piercing, 6 lbs, 10 gp_

Designed to unseat mounted enemies, while on foot a lance imposes disadvantage against targets within 5ft, but while mounted gains One-Handed and Punch. experts leverage their mount's strength behind each blow.

Untrained Awkward, Two-Handed, Reach, Melee d8, Brace

Proficient Two-Handed, Reach, Melee d12, Brace

Expert One-Handed, Reach, Melee 2d8, Brace, Stagger

Expert Perk
You can attempt a Shove as a bonus action. While mounted, after you successfully hit a target, you can attempt a shove as part of the same attack and gain advantage in the roll. Additionally, you no longer suffer disadvantage to attack rolls when you use this weapon on foot.
tiers: Untrained Awkward, Two-Handed, Reach, Melee d8, Brace
Proficient Two-Handed, Reach, Melee d12, Brace
Expert One-Handed, Reach, Melee 2d8, Brace, Stagger
equipment.expertPerk: You can attempt a Shove as a bonus action. While mounted, after you successfully hit a target, you can attempt a shove as part of the same attack and gain advantage in the roll. Additionally, you no longer suffer disadvantage to attack rolls when you use this weapon on foot.

equipment.name: Pike
equipment.description:
##### Pike

_Piercing, 8 lbs, 5 gp_

An 8-12 ft polearm designed for soldiers in a phalanx against an opposing line. A expert with the pike fights as a phalanx soldier, striking so deftly they can stop a charge.

Untrained Two-Handed, Heavy, Reach, Melee d10, Brace, Puncture

Proficient Two-Handed, Heavy, Reach, Melee d12, Brace, Lunge, Puncture

Expert Two-Handed, Heavy, Reach, Melee 2d8, Brace, Lunge, Punch, Puncture

Expert Perk
You ignore half cover. Additionally, if you hit with an attack on a target more than 5 ft away, it cannot move closer to you until the end of its next turn.
tiers: Untrained Two-Handed, Heavy, Reach, Melee d10, Brace, Puncture
Proficient Two-Handed, Heavy, Reach, Melee d12, Brace, Lunge, Puncture
Expert Two-Handed, Heavy, Reach, Melee 2d8, Brace, Lunge, Punch, Puncture

equipment.name: Ravenbeak
equipment.description:
##### Ravenbeak

_Piercing or Slashing, 3 lbs, 15 gp_

This pike has a crescent blade on the side of the tip used to hook or slash, at the cost of penetrative power. The expert can redirect attacks and disarm with ease.

Untrained Two-Handed, Heavy, Reach, Melee d8, Brace, Trip

Proficient Two-Handed, Heavy, Reach, Melee d10, Brace, Entangle, Lunge, Trip

Expert Two-Handed, Heavy, Reach, Melee d12, Brace, Disarm, Entangle, Lunge, Trip

Expert Perk
If an enemy misses you with a melee attack, as a reaction you can cause it to target a creature of your choosing within its reach with that same attack roll.
tiers: Untrained Two-Handed, Heavy, Reach, Melee d8, Brace, Trip
Proficient Two-Handed, Heavy, Reach, Melee d10, Brace, Entangle, Lunge, Trip
Expert Two-Handed, Heavy, Reach, Melee d12, Brace, Disarm, Entangle, Lunge, Trip
equipment.expertPerk: If an enemy misses you with a melee attack, as a reaction you can cause it to target a creature of your choosing within its reach with that same attack roll.

equipment.name: Trident
equipment.description:
##### Trident

_Piercing, 3 lbs, 10 gp_

The war trident has sharpened, thicker tines and is used as an axe just as often as a spear. The expert can trap, bind and disarm enemies with ease.

Untrained Awkward, One-Handed, Melee d8, Wound

Proficient One-Handed, Melee d8, Thrown (20/60), Versatile 2d4, Disarm, Wound

Expert One-Handed, Melee d12, Thrown (30/120), Versatile 3d4, Deflect, Disarm, Wound

Expert Perk
You can Deflect attacks against any target in reach. When you wield a trident with two hands, your enemy must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be disarmed when you Deflect.
tiers: Untrained Awkward, One-Handed, Melee d8, Wound
